Browse products

Customers search the catalogue before they buy. store.py already reads data/products.csv into a list of product dicts. In catalogue.py, write build_catalogue(products), which indexes the products by product_id, and find(catalogue, text), which returns the names of products still on sale (no discontinued_on) whose name contains text, ignoring case, sorted A to Z. main.py uses both to list every speaker.

DONE WHEN
◌
build_catalogue holds all 328 starter products, looked up by product_id
◌
find ignores case, skips discontinued products and sorts names A to Z
◌
main.py prints the product count and the 10 speakers on sale
